content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or a full time MBA/PGDM course having specialization in finance with good academic record from a recognized University/Institution; Preference would be given to Chartered Accountant; Officers of Organized Group 'A' Accounts Services and applicants from Central Govt./Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services working at appropriate level are exempted from the educational qualifications provided they have relevant experience as in Para 4(ii) Experience: At least five years of cumulative experience at a senior level during the last ten years in the area of Corporate Financial Management/Corporate Accounts in an organization of repute Age limit: Minimum 45 years (on the date of occurrence of vacancy (DOV)) Other conditions: Must be employed in a regular capacity, not contractual/ad-hoc, on the date of application and of interview SPSE, private company, JV or federation applicants: employer's annual turnover must be Rs. 5,000 crore or more CPSE applicants: one year in eligible scale for internal and two years for others as on date of vacancy Central Govt. Group 'A' officers: post of Joint Secretary level or equivalent on substantive basis Public Sector Bank/FI applicants: Board level or one level below for one year on date of application Armed Forces applicants: Major General level or equivalent; SPSE/private/JV/federation applicants: Board level or one level below Desirable: Preference to Chartered Accountant In case of private company, preference to candidates from listed companies

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for PESB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Employees in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity Officers drawing eligible pay scale merely on NFU/NBR basis without holding substantive post Applicants not clear from vigilance angle (applications not to be forwarded)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment for five years from date of joining or up to date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier Central Government officers, including Armed Forces, AIS and PSB/FI/Autonomous Body officers, considered only on immediate absorption basis Unwillingness to join after interview or offer leads to debarment for two years from Board level posts in CPSEs
